drivers.name: g_total
drivers.rationale: Revenue growth from year 2, one constant draw for each path (the engine has no fade). JUDGMENT. Mean 20% gives year-10 revenue of 542B from 105B. Base rate (market notes 3.4): the best 10-year result from a 30B start is AMZN 27.4% a year, equal to 397B from this base; from a 100B start the median is 6.7% and the maximum is 21.0%. Public forecasts: Damodaran 1,011B in year 10 (28.9% a year from his year 1); press: New Street 505B and Goldman more than 600B in 2030. The mean is between the base rate and the forecasts, nearer to the base rate. Std 8% is the spread of the 9-year rate: about 240B at P10 and 1,100B at P90 in year 10. Bounds 0% and 40% are 2.5 std from the mean.

drivers.name: core_margin
drivers.rationale: Mature FCFF margin: after tax, after capex, before the SBC charge. JUDGMENT. 22% less 6% SBC = 16% after SBC. Peers, FCF less SBC (market notes 3.1 and 3.2): MSFT, GOOGL and META 12% to 16% now, while they build AI capacity; 20% to 34% before; AMZN -7% to 5%. Damodaran: 19.0% in year 10, 13.9% in the terminal year. Std 6%: P10 to P90 is 8% to 24% after SBC. One draw moves all years by the same amount (engine limit). Bounds are 2.8 and 3.0 std from the mean.

drivers.name: margin_mix_drift
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC ramp. Year 1 is -7% before SBC. 9M2026: operating cash flow 6,569 - interest income 2,359 - capex 925 - lease prepayments 1,955 = 1,330 = 4.0% of revenue (L4692, L447, L4694, L4695). Committed spend in the next 12 months is 70.7B (L1655) = 67% of year-1 revenue; compute and infrastructure was 57% of 9M2026 revenue (L440): 4.0% - 10.7% = -6.7%. The prospectus says that short-term compute will compress the margin (L1617) and that operating and investing activities will use cash 'for the foreseeable future' (L2249). Linear to the mature level in year 8. Year 4 is +5.4%; the Goldman briefing (press) has the first positive free cash flow in 2030 at about 5.6% of revenue.

drivers.name: sbc_ratio
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC. Cost of NEW equity grants (IBM F5: SBC is a cash cost). The awards that exist are in the share count, thus their cost is not here, and the one-time 14.7B IPO charge (L2443) is not here. Year 1 25%: the grants after 2026-09-30 were 3.7B in 7 weeks (L6036), about 27B a year, on 105B of revenue; the 9M2026 grants were 542.9M RSUs at $49.38 and 91.2M options at $20.11 = 28.6B (L5719, L5683, L5691). Mature 6%: GOOGL 6.2%, between MSFT 3.7% and META 10.2%. Linear to year 8. The donation matching charges of future years (2,086 in 9M2026, L2090) are not here.

drivers.name: ma_ratio
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC 0. No evidence of material acquisitions: goodwill is 595 on 154,320 of assets.

drivers.name: ma_recurrence
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC 0, paired with ma_ratio 0. No growth credit.

drivers.name: rf
drivers.rationale: 10-year Treasury par yield 5.07%, 2026-11-18 (market notes 1.5). Std 0.5% (repo convention).

drivers.name: beta
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC JUDGMENT 1.40. ANT has no price history. Peer 5-year betas: median 1.38, range 0.98 to 2.25. Damodaran industry betas: software 1.28, semiconductor 1.52, internet software 1.69. Fixed compute commitments increase the risk of the equity. Locus 1.10 / 1.40 / 1.70 in the runner.

drivers.name: kd_spread
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC 2.0% above rf. JUDGMENT for a BB+ rating (Damodaran slides). Not calibrated. No effect on WACC at equity weight 1.0; the runner uses it for the commitments-as-debt sensitivity.

drivers.name: tax_rate
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC statutory 21%. Used on the debt shield only.

drivers.name: equity_weight
drivers.rationale: DETERMINISTIC 1.0. Debt is 1.7B of finance leases against more than 200B of cash. The rollover notes are shares. Cash is not negative debt in the weights. WACC = cost of equity.
